description: Locked toolchain for Telegram X HarmonyOS builds (GOV-002). tools/ci/setup-check.sh validates the local environment against this file; any mismatch fails the check with a non-zero exit code.

deveco.note: DevEco Studio installation root; everything below is derived from it.

sdk.sdkHomeNote: hvigor's SDK scanner expects DEVECO_SDK_HOME to be the PARENT of the SDK instance dir (it scans <sdkHome>/<subdir>/sdk-pkg.json). hvigorw exports DEVECO_SDK_HOME=sdkHome, not sdk.path.

hvigor.note: DevEco-bundled hvigor; project hvigorw is a thin wrapper around it.

node.note: Build node ONLY. Do not run hvigor with the system node (v23/v24).

abiNote: Phone / arm64 first (ADR-001). x86_64 is emulator/CI only.
